opportunities.title: NSF 23-605: Faculty Early Career Development Program (CAREER)
opportunities.notes: The Faculty Early Career Development (CAREER) Program is a Foundation-wide activity that offers the National Science Foundation's most prestigious awards in support of early-career faculty who have the potential to serve as academic role models in research and education.

opportunities.title: NSF 24-500: CISE Core Programs (IIS, CCF, CNS)
opportunities.notes: Supports research on Information and Intelligent Systems (IIS), Computing and Communication Foundations (CCF), and Computer and Network Systems (CNS). Open submission window with Small, Medium, and Large project categories.

opportunities.title: NSF 24-504: Secure and Trustworthy Cyberspace (SaTC)
opportunities.notes: Addresses cybersecurity and privacy challenges through fundamental research in computing, social, behavioral, and economic sciences.

opportunities.title: NSF 23-610: Smart Health and Biomedical Research in the Era of AI (SCH)
opportunities.notes: Interagency program with NIH supporting high-risk, high-reward research in AI-driven biomedical analytics, pervasive sensing, and personalized health delivery systems.

opportunities.title: NIH PA-20-185: Research Project Grant (Parent R01)
opportunities.notes: The NIH Research Project Grant supports a discrete, specified, circumscribed project to be performed by the named investigator(s) in an area representing the investigator's specific interest and competencies.

opportunities.title: NIH PA-20-195: Exploratory/Developmental Research Grant (Parent R21)
opportunities.notes: Encourages exploratory and developmental research projects in medical informatics, computational biology, and early-stage investigative methodologies.

opportunities.title: DARPA-RA-24-01: Young Faculty Award (YFA)
opportunities.notes: Identifies and engages rising research stars in junior faculty positions across mathematical sciences, computing, and microsystems to address national security challenges.

opportunities.title: DOE DE-FOA-0003180: Early Career Research Program
opportunities.notes: Supports individual research programs of outstanding scientists early in their careers in Advanced Scientific Computing Research (ASCR), Basic Energy Sciences (BES), and High Energy Physics.

opportunities.title: NSF 24-511: Cyberinfrastructure for Emerging Science (CESER)
opportunities.notes: Fosters early-stage development of innovative cyberinfrastructure technologies, scientific data pipelines, and high-performance computing clusters.

opportunities.title: NSF 23-568: Expanding AI Innovation through Partnerships (ExpandAI)
opportunities.notes: Promotes capacity building and research collaborations between emerging research institutions and National Artificial Intelligence Research Institutes.
